summary: Kamala Harris was San Francisco district attorney, California attorney general and a U.S. senator before serving as vice president under Joe Biden from 2021 to 2025. She became the Democratic nominee after Biden withdrew in 2024 and lost to Donald Trump. She leads many 2028 primary polls and has kept a political operation through her Fight for the People PAC, but has not decided whether to run.
